m3-write-routing.title: Route the writes: claim, release, empty-set cleanup
m3-write-routing.imperative: In handle_post_tool_use route the claim write, the release delete and the empty-set cleanup through binding_key(data). The nudge-ledger delete on release KEEPS the bare session_id, with a comment at the code site saying why.
